simple.meaning: חִנְטָא (chinṭâʼ) is a Hebrew object word meaning “wheat.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Ezra 6:9. The surrounding context includes offering, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חִנְטָא (H2591) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: חִנְטָא (chinṭâʼ) / H2591 is traced through Ezra 6:9, Ezra 7:22 with generated occurrence evidence.
